mapper.select: SELECT ca.id, ca.source_scheme_id, ca.teaching_task_id, ca.classroom_id, ca.time_slot_id, ca.consecutive_slots, ca.status, ca.created_at, ca.updated_at, tt.course_id, tt.primary_teacher_id AS teacher_id, (SELECT ttcg.class_group_id FROM teaching_task_class_group ttcg WHERE ttcg.teaching_task_id = tt.id LIMIT 1) AS class_group_id FROM course_assignment ca JOIN teaching_task tt ON ca.teaching_task_id = tt.id WHERE ca.id = #{id}
